resources.string: Convert videos this phone cannot play smoothly
This phone has no hardware decoder for this video at its size and speed, so it plays it with the processor and spends more battery. Converting makes an H.264 copy that the phone decodes in hardware.
Battery saver is on, so new videos were not converted. Their pages can convert them.
Converting a video can take a while. Allow notifications to see its progress and stop it while the app is closed. If you decline, videos convert exactly the same, without the notification.
